I’ve been very impressed with these VEVOR log lifting tongs. They are heavy-duty, well built, and make moving logs with my tractor much easier than trying to mess with chains or straps every time. The jaws bite into the wood securely, and once the weight is on them they hold extremely well. They open wide enough for the size logs I normally deal with, and the construction feels solid enough that I’m not worried about bending or breaking them under normal use. What I like most is how much time they save. Hooking onto a log is quick, lifting is simple, and I can move or reposition logs without getting off the tractor over and over again. For clearing property, moving downed trees, or handling firewood-sized logs, they’re a very handy attachment to have around. For the price, I think they are an excellent value. Simple tool, heavy construction, and they do exactly what they’re supposed to do. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone using a tractor, loader, or other equipment for moving logs.
